moments.title: Workers occupy key plants
moments.facts: Workers occupied plants and held production capacity in place. Supporters brought food; the occupation made replacing them harder.
moments.interpretation: The company had to bargain once the workers controlled production it needed.

moments.title: Recognition through negotiation
moments.facts: GM agreed to recognize the UAW as bargaining agency for employees who were union members and to begin negotiations over the remaining issues.
moments.interpretation: The agreement followed a six-week occupation and the governor's decision not to force an eviction that risked bloodshed.
moments.difference: The game agreement changes wages and hours; it does not create union recognition or reproduce Flint's plant occupation.
